The '''''Undisputed Victor''''' was a [[Yacht (aquatic)|yacht]] captained by [[Baron]] [[Yasto Attsmun]].<ref name="Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing" /> In [[34 ABY]], the yacht sailed over the [[Sea of Cantonica]], the artificial [[Ocean|sea]] located on [[Cantonica]] next to [[Canto Bight]].<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>
